notes.title: Guardian Angel permanent skill added
notes.content:
Small update according to Stealthygolem feedback:
- Added Guardian Angel permanent skill (unlocked after winning Adventure 1 on nightmare) - I believe in second chances :)
- Camera-turrets deal half the damage now
- No more big aliens on level 1 in Chapter 3
- Tweaked a map on Chapter 3 a little bit
- Few small other fixes

notes.title: Intergalactic Tracker!
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- You now have a chance to encounter the Intergalactic Tracker during your adventures. If you manage to defeat him, you might obtain one of his powerful weapons or pieces of armor. Be aware though: he's very strong and has many skills up his sleeve!
- 3 new achievements related to the Intergalactic Tracker
- Fixed bugs related to the Warrioress (skill lock)
- Fixed a bug related to attack-movement with ranged weapons (the character was chasing enemies into close range)
- Other minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Killing Spree mechanism added + bug fixes
notes.content:
Patch notes:

- Killing Spree meter! Every kill within a few seconds fills the Killing Spree meter. The more you get, the bigger the XP reward. (100 kills also grant an epic item drop.)
- Decreased bloom and disabled HP bar transparency (especially helpful in Chapter 2).
- Fixed a few issues with boss music.
- Fixed a bug that caused players to receive twice the XP for a reward.
- Fixed a bug with properly setting the max level of the Chaos Challenge.
- Added a warning when leaving a level with keyboard upgrades available.
- Fixed a bug that allowed exploiting the 3rd enhanced attack with Keyboard 360 or Piercing Arrow.
- Fixed a bug that displayed secondary objectives for level 5 of the Chaos Challenge.
- Zombies now correctly leave bloodstains on the floor after exploding (if the option is enabled).
- Shift + LMB now works the same way as RMB (attack from place if in range, move towards enemy only if out of range).

notes.content: [p][b]Chapter 4 has been delivered to the official branch! 🙂[/b][/p][p]And with it comes:[/p][list][*][p]3 new Adventures in a brand-new environment[/p][/*][*][p]Over 20 new enemies[/p][/*][*][p]3 bosses[/p][/*][*][p]2 new playable Characters to unlock![/p][/*][*][p]1 new NPC to unlock[/p][/*][*][p]New items, new rewards, and new achievements![/p][/*][/list][p][b]This patch also includes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Further gameplay smoothness improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Various small enhancements and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enjoy! 🙂[/b][/p]

notes.title: Quick fix patch
notes.content: Fixed a bug related to Adventure 3 boss arena (no proper music triggered), bug related to aiming with gamepad (for some abilities) and small bug related to the intro screen.

notes.title: Small optimization patch
notes.content:
Made some optimization in graphics rendering, should result in few more fps.
Additionallly fixed annoying bug displaying "Jasio Games" screen every time when entering Main Menu ;).

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with the character not attacking/moving to a target when clicked/pressed "attack"

notes.title: Hotfix (no more crashes hopefully)
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs:
- occasionally crash should not appear now
- landmines are not triggered from the other side of the wall
- turrets should not fire through walls anymore

Also one improvement added:
- after unlocking all legendary powers, every 10 manuscripts will drop random legendary item at the altar

notes.title: Chapter 3 is live!
notes.content:
- NEW CHAPTER! :) 3 new Adventures (= 15 levels) with 3 new Bosses. One new NPC to unlock and 2 new playable characters. Tons of new items, enemies and traps. And also new game mode to unlock.
- 7 new permanent skills
- 12 new achievements
- few small adjustments and bug fixes

notes.title: First adventure from Chapter 3 available on Beta branch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First, I want to share that due to some big (and positive!) changes in my personal life, I had to make a lot of preparations, which caused a slight delay in Chapter 3. However, I still plan to release version 1.0 of Gah! this year.

Chapter 3 is almost ready, and I’ve just uploaded the first adventure to the Beta branch. If you’d like to try it, right-click on Gah!, select Properties, go to the Beta tab, and choose the Beta branch from the list. (And don’t forget to share your feedback on our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/DZFcjWVzyu).

The rest of the adventures in Chapter 3 are about 85% complete. I’ll need another 2-3 weeks to finalize everything before officially uploading it to the main branch.

Thank you for your patience, and see you in the next update! :)

notes.title: Hotfix patch
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where teleporting/dashing could place players outside the walls.
- Fixed an issue where legendary items sometimes lacked their special powers when available.
- Nerfed Dark Altar guardians, especially on Nightmare difficulty.

notes.title: New patch is live now (Dark Altars and Legendary Items)
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Dark Altars introduced: Occasionally, you will encounter a Dark Altar that summons very strong enemies upon activation. If you manage to defeat them, you will earn loot as a reward and a small amount of Ancient Manuscripts.
- Ancient Manuscripts: A new collectible "material". If you complete the level, your manuscripts will be saved. Once you've collected at least 10, you can visit the Legendary Book in the Village to unlock a random legendary power.
- New item rarity added: Legendary! Legendary items have better stats than epic items and may feature special legendary powers, provided you unlock them with Ancient Manuscripts.
- Added information about the rewards for completing an adventure on Nightmare difficulty.
- Other small fixes.

notes.title: Early Access 0.6.7 is live
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Added a separate tab in Options showing gamepad controls.
- Further improvements to Left Mouse Button attacks.
- Added an option to disable Left Mouse Button attacks (for those who preferred the previous way of playing).
- Added a visual weapon/arrow effect when basic attacks apply elemental damage (e.g., from jewelry).
- Added keybindings for Inventory, Skills, Character Sheet, and Map.
- Added an alternative keyboard movement option—default keys are now: ASDW for movement, 1234 for skills, Q to pick the nearest item, I for inventory, K for skills, C for character, and M for the map.
- Custom keybindings now appear on the GUI.
- Skill icons are now grayed out when out of mana.
- Reduced Piercing Arrow range slightly.
- A visual effect now appears for every third attack mana gain.
- The item reward from bonus objectives is now always usable by the character.
- Potions are no longer displayed in the inventory (allowing for 2 more item slots).
- Fixed a bug with zooming in/out on the menu screen.
- Fixed a bug affecting animation when making very quick attack and movement sequences.
- Other small fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: Early Access 0.6.6 is live
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Profiles! (separate progress for up to 3 people, so more people can play from the same computer)
- Mouse controls adjusted*.
- Some performance optimization.
- Fixed few small gamepad-related bugs.
- Fixed a bug with entering menu when on level-up screen.
- Few small adjustments (for example level up panel improvement).
- Fixed a bug with Warrioress not doing damage with second and third dash.
- Enemies should no longer be able to attack through walls.

* - from now on the LMB is used for moving, interacting and attacking and works fine also when clicking constantly instead of holding the button (but holding the button still works of course). RMB is now only used for holding position and attacking (the character will only move when enemy is out of range). I think this improves the experience for all types of players, but as usual let me know if you have any further suggestions :). Smoothness of gameplay is crazy important in this kind of game, so I want to make it as good as possible.

notes.title: Early Access 0.6.5 is now live (controller and Steam Deck support!)
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Gamepad support!! (also game is now playable on Steam Deck)
- Added a gentle cartoon shader (graphics looks a bit better now, I hope)
- Stairs contains a small surprise now ;)
- Adjusted item drop rates and item rarity a bit (in the player's favor)
- Enemies should no longer spawn outside of the walls
- Added some new sounds for critical kills
- Showing the secondary objective reward on the screen
- Map zoom is now saved between levels
- Game will now pause when window lose focus or when gamepad will be disconnected
- Added more blood as an option
- Steam Cloud save is now enabled
- Added possibility to change name with gamepad
- Added small map indicator to chests and altars that were already used
- Other small bug fixes and adjustments

As usual please let me know on Discord in case of any comments/suggestions/bugs found :).

notes.title: Early Access 0.6.4 is live now
notes.content:
- Added a wishing well in the village (so you can throw away all your gold from endless mode).
- Fixed the description window in the inventory for 16:10 and other screen ratios.
- 'A' will no longer try to pick up potions when you already have the full amount.
- Fixed issues with wall transparency in Chapter 2.
- You cannot be stuck outside of the boss area in Adventure 1 in Chapter 2 anymore (hopefully).
- Alt+tab should no longer disable items names.
- Alt+tab now pauses the music.
- No more white dots on Chapter 2 map.
- Added brightness setting.
- Added an option to scale UI (it's kind of experimental, let me know if you notice any weird behavior).
- Adjusted fonts.
- The shopkeeper now always stocks health potions.
- Shop items are now sorted.
- Added a checkbox in Options to skip the intro.
- Added light armor boots to Chapter 2! ;)

notes.title: Patch 0.6.3.1 is now live
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Added the last level of passive tree (6 new skills)
- Added level uping after level 20 (for now only stat boost, I will add some bonuses to choose in the future)
- Added small notification in bottom-left corner after passive skill is auto-incremented
- The shopkeeper offers better items now
- Gold and orbs are now displayed in clearer way
- Fixed bug with keybindings breaking sorcerer's Q ability and some secondary objectives

notes.title: Patch 0.6.3 is ready
notes.content:
- Fixed a rare but annoying bug with invalid level generation that prevented level completion.
- Invisible walls in Chapter 2 should no longer be an issue.
- Items should no longer get stuck on walls.
- Fixed minimap refresh issues.
- Players can no longer regenerate life after death.
- Fixed a bug preventing doors from opening when standing too close.
- Totems should no longer spawn on bookshelves.
- Bonuses should no longer get stuck in objects.
- Other small adjustments.

notes.title: Gah! is now released in Early Access!
notes.content:
You can now buy Gah! with a 40% launching discount :).
I encourage you to write a review and visit game's Discord: https://discord.gg/DZFcjWVzyu

Enjoy! :)

notes.title: Early Access 0.6.2 version is ready
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- New playable character: Warrioress
- 19 new Steam Achievements (24 in summary)
- New perma skill - drop random items at the beginning of the Adventure
- Pressing 'A' now collects the nearest item
- Balance adjustments (some bosses nerfed, some buffed, in general early game should be easier and the late game a bit harder)
- A fair amount of gameplay adjustments, according to the feedback from beta tests (for example: different colors of potions on the map, clearer character panel, bigger hit boxes for the enemies and more…)
- Minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Beta 0.6.0 is ready!
notes.content:
After working after hours for the past 6 months the Beta version of Gah! is ready.
Here are the patch notes:

Whole new Chapter set in different realm with new enemies, items, etc.
5 new bosses (2 for the first chapter and 3 for the second)
New character: Sorcerer
New character: Knight
New character: Sensei
New character: Rogue
New character: Sheriff
New offhand type: Shield
New offhand type: Tome
New weapon type: Rifle
New game mode - Endless Chaos (play until you die)
LOTS of performance improvements
Graphic improvements
Balance improvements
Added 3 videos (intro and one for finishing each chapter)
Achievements implemented ;) (I still need to add more, but the mechanics are working)
Added graveyard
Added Keybindings
New UI
Lot more items
More skills in permanent skills tree
New reward: Pet
New reward: The Vault
New reward: Map Intel
Added random tips on the loading screen.

After testing the build for enough time I'll ask Steam for the beta keys so I can start Closed Beta and gather more feedback :)
